step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage PTAT reference circuit that operates MOSFETs in weak inversion and uses log companding to generate a temperature-dependent current or voltage. It is designed to allow supply scaling below the sum of threshold voltages.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the reference circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of V*I for all supply sources (VDD at 1.8V, LABEL_NETs at 0.9V)
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper targets sub-5uW operation. In SKY130, with similar weak-inversion biasing, the power should remain in the low microwatt range.

psrr.description: Power Supply Rejection Ratio at 100 Hz

sky130_expected.calculation: 20 * log10(I_out_DC / I_out_AC) with 1V AC on the 0.9V supply
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 60 dB. SKY130 devices at L=0.5um should provide sufficient intrinsic gain to achieve similar rejection, though short-channel effects might slightly degrade it compared to 1.2um.

ptat_slope.description: Temperature coefficient of the output current

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a typical nominal output current of ~1uA at 300K, a perfectly PTAT current will have a slope of approximately 1uA / 300K = 3.3 nA/C.

current_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of the output current due to process variations

sky130_expected.calculation: Monte Carlo simulation of output current at room temperature
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports around 5% standard deviation. SKY130 mismatch characteristics will yield similar results depending on the final device area (W*L).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption, AC PSRR, and DC temperature sweep for PTAT slope.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PTAT Reference Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 N4 LABEL_NET_0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 N4 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 LABEL_NET_2 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 N5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

.control
  * DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let pwr = - (i(VVDD)*1.8 + i(VLABEL_NET_0)*0.9 + i(VLABEL_NET_1)*0.9 + i(VLABEL_NET_2)*0.9)
  print pwr
  let i_dc_val = -i(VLABEL_NET_2)
  print i_dc_val
  * Save DC current to a variable for AC PSRR calculation
  set i_dc_set = $&i_dc_val

  * AC Analysis for PSRR
  ac dec 10 1 1G
  let psrr_db = 20 * log10( abs($i_dc_set) / (mag(i(VLABEL_NET_2)) + 1e-15) )
  meas ac psrr_100Hz find psrr_db at=100

  * DC Sweep for PTAT behavior
  dc temp -40 125 5
  let i_out_temp = -i(VLABEL_NET_2)
  meas dc i_out_m40 find i_out_temp at=-40
  meas dc i_out_125 find i_out_temp at=125
  let ptat_slope = (i_out_125 - i_out_m40) / 165
  print ptat_slope
  
  quit
.endc
